title: Herbal Smoked Japanese Mackerel Katsudon
description: A low-sodium Japanese dish featuring smoked mackerel, binchotan-charcoal, and herbal flavors, served in a crispy katsudon form. This monsoon-inspired dish is perfect for a hearty lunch.
instructions: Start by rehydrating the dried shiitake mushrooms in hot water for 10 minutes.
Prepare the Japanese rice according to the package instructions.
Smoke the mackerel fillets using binchotan charcoal for 5 minutes on each side.
In a large bowl, whisk together low-sodium soy sauce, rice vinegar, and sesame oil.
Add the rehydrated mushrooms, green onions, and chopped cilantro to the bowl and mix well.
Cut the smoked mackerel into small pieces and add to the bowl, mixing gently.
In a separate bowl, mix together panko breadcrumbs and a pinch of salt.
Dip each mackerel piece into the breadcrumb mixture, coating evenly.
Heat about 1/2 inch of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and fry the breaded mackerel until golden brown and crispy.
To assemble the katsudon, place a scoop of Japanese rice in a bowl, add a few pieces of the fried mackerel, and spoon some of the mushroom and herb mixture over the top.
